easyPrerequisites: Tidewater Minion doesn't have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding nine mana of any color due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Lotus Field
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Tidewater Minion.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
